S85.01.note: The photo upload is on General and the email change is on Account, not in one place. Files found; behaviour not judged.
steps: Sign in, press ⌘, or open Settings, and click General.
In the Full name box, change the name and click Save profile.
Wait for the word Saved, then reload the page.
Check the new name is still shown. Open Account and check the email row is there, then compare with Expected (name, photo, email).
S85.01.where: Settings > General > Full name (email is under Settings > Account)

S85.02.note: The settings screen does not say the instructions are limited to one surface; the server applies them in apps/web/lib/services/turn-context-service.ts. Scope was not verified.
steps: Open Settings and click Personalization.
Scroll to the heading Instructions for AGI and type text in the box under it (a counter shows the character limit).
Make sure the switch beside Apply instructions for AGI is on.
Start a new chat, send a message, and check the reply follows the instruction.
Turn the switch off, send another message, and check the instruction no longer applies.
Open Settings and click Personalization.
Under the heading Style and tone, open Response style and pick a value; then open Response length and pick a value.
Under Characteristics, change Warmth or Headers and lists if you want.
Start a new chat, send the same question, and compare the reply's tone, length and formatting with the choices.
Click Reset response style to undo the changes and check the reply changes back.
S85.03.where: Settings > Personalization > Style and tone (Response style, Response length, Characteristics)

S85.04.needs: a sample of your own writing
S85.04.note: Exact text of the form field labels and the save button was not read; only the trigger and Create Custom Style were confirmed.
steps: Open a chat and click the Response style control in the message box.
Click Create Custom Style.
Enter a name, paste a sample of your own writing, and add an instruction, then save.
Select the new style, send a message, and compare the reply with your sample's style.
Open the same menu and check the style is still listed, and that Edit and Delete work for it.
S85.04.where: Chat composer > Response style > Create Custom Style

S85.05.note: The memory editor lives in packages/ui/unified-chat, not in the settings file.
steps: Open Settings and click Personalization.
Under Memory, check the switch labelled Persistent memory.
In the memory editor, type in the box labelled Add a new fact and add a fact; use the Search memory box to find it.
Edit a fact, then delete one and confirm in the dialog Delete this memory? (button Delete memory).
Turn Persistent memory off, start a chat, and check the saved facts are not used; compare with Expected.

S85.06.needs: at least one earlier saved chat
S85.06.note: The temporary-chat exclusion is only stated in the Privacy copy (Not saved to history or search); it was not verified in the code path.
steps: Open Settings and click Personalization.
Under Memory, find the switch labelled Search past chats and turn it on.
Start a chat, ask about something you discussed in an earlier chat, and check the reply uses it.
Turn Search past chats off, ask the same question in a new chat, and check the earlier chat is no longer used.
Start a temporary chat and check it is not used for references; compare with Expected.

labels.text: Use memories from outside this project

S85.07.note: The button that opens the project settings dialog was not confirmed in the code; the Memory row and its text are confirmed.
steps: Click Projects in the sidebar and open a project.
Open the project's settings dialog.
Under Memory, tick or untick Use memories from outside this project.
Click save in the dialog, then start a chat inside the project.
Compare: ticked means account memories are used too; unticked means only this project's memories.
S85.07.where: Projects > open a project > project settings > Memory > Use memories from outside this project

S85.10.needs: the Desktop app on a Mac and Chrome with the extension installed
S85.10.note: The Chrome nav field is listed only in the hosted/desktop settings navigation; the site-by-site control was not found in this app.
steps: Open Settings and click Capabilities.
Find the Chrome section and read its status (Install extension, Paired and answering, or Paired, not answering right now).
Click Unpair this browser? and confirm in the dialog.
Check the status changes to not paired.
Per-site permission is set inside the Chrome extension, not here; compare with Expected.

S85.11.note: Searched apps/web/features/settings and the composer for chat history, Save chat history, keep chats and history toggles; found no control. Closest is Start new chats as temporary in Settings > Privacy.

labels.text: Only use models that do not train on your chats

S85.12.note: Owner decision on this item is still open, and the page says nothing is used for this today.
steps: Open Settings and click Privacy.
Scroll to the section headed Help improve (product name) models.
Read the note under the toggles, then check the switches Use my chats and Use my voice are off by default.
Turn one on, reload, and check it stays on; turn it off again.
Also check Only use models that do not train on your chats, under the Privacy list; compare with Expected.
S85.12.where: Settings > Privacy > Help improve AGI models > Use my chats and Use my voice

S85.14.note: Whether a report is actually sent cannot be seen from the screen.
steps: Open Settings and click Privacy.
Find the switch labelled Share crash and error reports, which is off by default.
Turn it on, reload the page, and check it stays on; then turn it off and reload.
Compare the switch with its saved state; the code that reads it is in apps/web/lib/sentry-shared.ts and was not run.
S85.14.where: Settings > Privacy > Share crash and error reports

S85.16.note: The composer's per-chat toggle overrides this setting.
steps: Open Settings and click Privacy.
Turn on the switch Start new chats as temporary.
Click New chat, send a message, and check the chat is marked temporary.
Check the chat is not in the sidebar history after the reply.
Turn the switch off and start a new chat; compare with Expected.
S85.16.where: Settings > Privacy > Start new chats as temporary

S85.17.needs: at least one archived chat (archive one from the sidebar first)
S85.17.note: Recently deleted is a separate list (DeletedChatsSection.tsx) reached from Privacy; its link was not traced step by step.
steps: Open Settings, click Privacy, and find Archived chats; click Manage.
Read the list under Archived chats; each chat row offers Restore.
Click Restore on one chat and check it returns to the sidebar.
Archive another chat, open Delete all archived or delete one chat, read the dialog, and confirm.
Check the chat moves to Recently deleted for 30 days.

labels.text: Delete all chats in this workspace

S85.18.needs: a test account with several chats (destructive)
S85.18.note: The copy says in this workspace; check whether a personal account sees the same wording. The Archived list has its own Delete all archived.
steps: Open Settings and click Privacy.
Scroll to the row Delete all chats in this workspace and click Delete all.
Read the dialog and its confirm button Delete all chats; check it says chats can be restored from Recently deleted within 30 days.
Cancel first and check nothing changed; then, only with a test account, confirm and check the list is empty.
S85.18.where: Settings > Privacy > Delete all chats in this workspace > Delete all

S85.19.needs: an account with a shared chat link (create one from a chat first)
S85.19.note: Published pages are handled by PublishedArtifactsSection.tsx, which was not traced to a visible entry point.
steps: Open Settings, click Privacy, find Shared links and click Manage.
Read the list under Shared links, which shows the title and Anyone with the link or Workspace only.
Click Revoke on one link, read the dialog Revoke this public link?, and click Revoke link.
Open the old link in a private window and check it no longer opens; the list should drop the row.
S85.19.where: Settings > Privacy > Shared links > Manage, then Revoke

S85.20.needs: an account with some chats or memories
S85.20.note: Files found; not verified that each category is in the archive.
steps: Open Settings and click Privacy.
Click Export data and wait for the label Preparing to finish.
When Download your export appears, click it to save the archive.
Open the archive and check it holds chats, memory, files and settings; compare with Expected.

labels.text: Import memory from other AI providers

S85.22.needs: a memory export file from another assistant
S85.22.note: The confirm button text in the dialog was not read.
steps: Open Settings and click Personalization.
Under Memory, click Start import next to Import memory from other AI providers.
In the dialog, upload a memory export file (Upload a memory export file), then select the memories to import.
Confirm the import and check the new memories appear in the memory list (Memory facts).
Compare with Expected; the final confirm button label was not read in the code.
S85.22.where: Settings > Personalization > Memory > Import memory from other AI providers > Start import

S85.26.needs: a disposable test account (scheduling deletion cannot be undone before the deadline)
S85.26.note: Deletion is scheduled, not immediate; erasure follows after the deadline.
steps: Open Settings and click Account.
Scroll to the row Delete account and click it.
Read the dialog Delete your account?; it says deletion is scheduled and can be cancelled before the deadline.
Type DELETE in the box, then click Schedule deletion only on a disposable account; otherwise cancel.
Compare with Expected: an explicit confirmation is required before scheduling.
